profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | AI Systems & Full-Stack Platforms | LLM Applications, Next.js, TypeScript, Go, AWS
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer and forward-deployed AI engineer with 8+ years of experience shipping production systems across AI, SaaS, fintech, and enterprise platforms.

I build from zero to one and modernize complex systems—turning ambiguous product needs into reliable, measurable outcomes. At BNSF Railway, I independently built FreightPulse, a greenfield AI-powered sales-intelligence platform, owning discovery, UX, architecture, implementation, and rollout to four sales teams in roughly three months. I designed the LLM interpretation layer, reconciled 427,855 units and $755.7M against source systems, and delivered an improvement that reduced alert noise by 68%.

Previously, I led platform and architecture at Amazon, AvidXchange, and Bank of America, delivering Next.js/React, TypeScript, Go, Python, PostgreSQL, AWS, design systems, micro-frontends, serverless APIs, and AI-powered workflows.

I’m interested in remote roles where I can own AI-enabled products, platform architecture, and end-to-end delivery—from product discovery through production.

Core keywords: AI systems, LLM applications, full-stack engineering, platform engineering, system design, Next.js, React, TypeScript, Go, Python, PostgreSQL, AWS, design systems, developer experience.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built and launched FreightPulse, a greenfield AI-powered sales-intelligence platform, owning discovery, UX, architecture, development, and rollout to four sales teams in roughly three months.
• Designed an LLM interpretation layer that explains why alerts matter and drafts seller follow-ups.
• Reconciled 427,855 units and $755.7M against source systems, catching material calculation errors and delivering an improvement that reduced alert noise by 68%.
• Architected the production platform across Next.js, Go, PostgreSQL, and AWS, including SSO, automated data refreshes, high availability, monitoring, and continuous delivery.
• Led modernization of three legacy Java applications, fixing the defect behind 22 consecutive pipeline failures and delivering the suite two weeks ahead of target.
positions.insights: Skills: PostgreSQL · Go (Programming Language) · Large Language Models (LLM) · Systems Design · Generative AI

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led migration of a high-traffic, vendor-dependent product to a modern Next.js 15, TypeScript, and AWS stack, establishing platform foundations for long-term scale.
• Built shared UI component architecture and accessibility governance across 100+ components, standardizing keyboard, focus, ARIA, and WCAG behaviors.
• Delivered end-to-end frontend, API, and infrastructure capabilities with CDK-managed deployments and cache-safe rollouts.
• Owned serverless API patterns—including middleware, standardized errors, rate limiting, WAF controls, and cold-start optimizations—for 20+ CloudFront-backed routes.
positions.insights: Skills: React · Enterprise Software · Software Design · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · TypeScript · Server Side Programming · Data Analysis · Go (Programming Language) · Systems Design

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led frontend and platform work unifying 20+ applications into a single supplier–buyer experience using Next.js, React, and TypeScript.
• Created and scaled a governed design system with 50+ reusable components, contribution workflows, and enablement across 7+ teams.
• Led monorepo adoption and modernization, migrating 11 applications and personally delivering six while establishing upgrade playbooks.
• Built an AI-powered text-to-call workflow with ElevenLabs, enabling agents to process concurrent invoice calls and autonomously manage accounts payable.
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · React · Cypress · Python (Programming Language) · Next.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · TypeScript · HTML · Systems Design · Generative AI

positions.title: Application Architect
positions.description:
• Built and standardized a React micro-frontend platform with Module Federation and shared runtime contracts for routing, authentication, configuration, and observability.
• Designed secure OAuth2/JWT session and identity foundations, partnering with backend teams to harden enterprise workflows and reduce authentication defects.
• Extracted common components and integrations into a bank-wide NPM library with versioning, adoption guidance, and governance.
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · React · Cypress · Python (Programming Language) · Next.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · TypeScript · HTML · Systems Design

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Replatformed a legacy kiosk into an IoT edge solution using React, Redux, Electron, Node, and GraphQL, deploying to 30 locations with resilient offline/online behavior.
• Built reusable modules and data-access patterns for state management, caching, and error handling across multiple workflows.
• Implemented facial recognition with face-api.js and AWS Rekognition plus an ID-scan KYC API, automating operations across 30 locations and saving approximately $1.3M in annual payroll.
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · React · Cypress · Python (Programming Language) · Next.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · TypeScript · HTML

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
• Architected and developed the frontend of Cigent’s Enterprise Management Console for a cybersecurity defense platform using Ionic, React, Redux, and Material UI.
• Built a multi-tenant Flask/Python and PostgreSQL backend and helped deliver the cross-platform mobile application powering devices released to production.
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · React · Cypress · Python (Programming Language) · Next.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · TypeScript · HTML · PostgreSQL
